expectations.text: The page reuses the existing Button component and the CSS variables from theme.css (e.g. var(--color-accent), var(--color-surface)) instead of introducing new hard-coded colours or fonts
expectations.evidence: SettingsPage.jsx has `import { Button } from "./Button"` and renders `<Button type="submit" ...>`, and settings.css uses only variables such as `background: var(--color-surface)`, `accent-color: var(--color-accent)` and `font-family: var(--font-ui)`; the new colours (e.g. `--color-danger: #f87171`)

expectations.text: Form inputs have associated labels (label elements or aria-label) and the toggle is keyboard-accessible
expectations.evidence: Both inputs have matching labels, `<label htmlFor={nameId}>Display name</label>` and `<label htmlFor={notifyId}>Email notifications</label>`, and the toggle is a native `<input ... type="checkbox" role="switch">` with a `.settings-switch:focus-visible` outline, so it works from the keyboard.
